body: A service worker's own fetches carry no tab id, so they match no per-tab DNR rule and hit the shared jar. This is unfixable inside the extension model. Detect it per origin and report it on the badge. A tool that looks isolated while leaking is worse than no tool — this is the direct lesson from SessionHub at 3.7 of 5 and from the extensions Aman tried.
title: Surface the service-worker bypass instead of hiding it
